assumptions.source_location: Spezielle Rechte der Zauberer und Narren
alternatives: after a leading Fool, only the literal second card can establish the required suit
after a leading Fool, the first later ordinary suited card establishes the required suit when intervening cards are colorless specials
assumptions.selected: the first ordinary suited card after one or more leading Fools establishes the required suit; Wizards and Fools never establish a suit
